@default_cost: 26
@description:
 [Vocational] A henchman is usually a servant or employee of a more
 significant individual. For example a henchman could be a squire, bodyguard,
 valet, page, lady-in-waiting, messenger, butler, etc. A henchman often has
 access to his master's secrets and can call upon his master's protection so
 long as he serves faithfully. Time to Acquire: 31 months. Starting Money:
 normal.
